name: Team Finance arbitrary-pair migration drain
summary: LockToken.migrate() authorized the caller using one lock ID but accepted a separate caller-supplied Uniswap V2 pair and liquidity amount. The attacker used locks for a worthless self-made token to migrate other users' locked LP balances into attacker-controlled Uniswap V3 positions.
notes: The reset is the upgrade to the implementation whose migrate() the exploit ran; earlier implementations do not count (rule 7).

Loss is the USDC and ETH the migrations pulled out of the FEG, CAW, TSUKA, KNDX and STARS pairs whose LP Team Finance held, sent to the attacker or its own V3 pools. The second transaction drained the STARS lock.
CAW, TSUKA and the FEG, KNDX and STARS token sides are valued at nothing: draining their pairs' quote sides left no market to absorb them, and the attacker returned CAW and TSUKA unsold (rule 12).
